notes.title: Final Beta Stress Test – Help Us Prepare for Early Access!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have observed that many of you do not actively engage in the closed beta due to progress not being retained, often logging in briefly to explore before logging out. 

Only a small group of participants has provided constructive feedback. However, we assure you that the primary objective of this closed beta is to ensure a seamless and stable experience for the upcoming early access launch. 

Despite presenting what appears to be a fully developed game, we have received nearly some of bug reports, all of which our team is diligently addressing.

At this stage, we kindly ask for your support in one final test. To complete our operational pipeline and stay on track for an early access launch by the end of March, we must conduct a large-scale stress test to ensure our servers can efficiently scale to at least a few hundred concurrent users. This test is not meant to determine whether the servers will crash or become unresponsive but rather to verify that the system can handle average the expected connection load. 

Accordingly, Playtest access will be closed on Friday, February 10, 2025 at 23:59 CET and Playtest access will be reopened on

 Friday, February 14, 2025, 18:00 CET
We ask that all players log in at the same time to create an important stress test. 

Even logging in for just one hour would greatly support our efforts. This test will provide us with critical data on the scalability and performance of our early access servers under high traffic conditions.

We sincerely appreciate your cooperation and commitment. We look forward to ushering in a new era of gaming with you in early access!

You can participate in the following survey to reset the servers and start anew or to preserve the progress, according to the results of the survey the servers will be reset or the progress will be preserved. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/e7b33b5568c69e6702a2324aedd1ed9d76c1d40d.png

However, this only applies to the Playtest version, the server will be completely reset in early access, this will not change that.

Thank you for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Prank Day
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/5ef27ebb1add9a6094eef851259d6f8f85bbe3a7.png24 December Prank Day Event
Drinking maniac Kenrush is now selling his special concoctions for a week. Find him and try the effects of the drinks! Kenrush is located in the Teleportation square, you can buy the following drinks from him for Spirit points:

In a realm where the most extraordinary enchanting potions were a rare gift from the Aravonuria Deity, one man's insatiable desire led to a fateful bargain with the forces of Light and Darkness. Centuries-old recipes, guarded by prestigious brewing families, held the key to crafting the most renowned elixirs. A humble potion maker once swore an oath before the powers of Light and Darkness, pledging anything in exchange for the fame associated with the most potent concoctions. While the Guardians of Light disregarded the mortal's petty ambitions, the Lords of Darkness listened to his pleas.

A dream was sent to the destitute man, foretelling that his soon-to-be-born child would possess a miraculous ability to create unparalleled potions. The child, as foretold, exhibited these skills at a young age. However, the father, growing increasingly impatient, relentlessly pushed his child to concoct ever more extraordinary brews.

Thus, elixirs enhancing magical abilities were born, quickly becoming the most sought-after concoctions in the father's potion shop. But with insatiable greed, the father coerced his child into creating new recipes. However, as the concoctions grew more exceptional, so did the child's detachment from reality, leading to increasingly peculiar behaviors. The townsfolk, witnessing the transformation, dubbed him the "foolish child."

Despite the warnings, the father persisted, extracting the two most extraordinary potions from his child: the Divine Master's Life Elixir and the Blessing of the Dragon. Yet, the moment the last potion was complete, the child's mind irreversibly shattered, finding solace only in songs, jokes, and entertaining the people.

On the day the child returned home wearing a jester's hat, singing ballads with an ever-present smile, the father realized the extent of his actions and the fate he imposed on his only child. He copied the recipes and distributed them across the empire, redistributing his wealth to the needy. His sole purpose became finding a cure for his child. By day, he silently watched over the child, and by night, he delved into ancient books seeking the healing recipe.

Meanwhile, in blissful ignorance, Kenrush lived his days. His cheerful songs, jokes, and stories brought laughter even to the grumpiest souls. Occasionally, he sneaked into the yards of potion masters, concocting funny brews that echoed with laughter throughout the courtyards.

The hearts of the Guardians of Light softened towards Kenrush. They bestowed blessings, and through the Dragon Deity's priests, declared that Kenrush's potions posed no harm or illness. Therefore, every year, under the supervision of the priests, Kenrush could sell his potions for a week, bringing joy even in troubled times. This annual event, celebrated in the spirit of merriment, was aptly named "Prank Day" by the inhabitants of the imperial city.

Kenrush could be found at Teleport Square, offering the following potions for Spirit points:


 KaBOomm Elixir: Upon use, comic book bubbles appear on enemies when struck.  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/380f3e1635fe1f3af958f41e5bc3d26ff4d12ab8.png
 Forbidden Elixir: Lose control over your character, mimics the experience of being drunk.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/ff316c9f0cd1c9518ab2995b55b9b7b1f927cd4d.png Brobdingnagian Elixir: Increases your character's size twofold upon consumption. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/22514c5ba891228eb586be0bd9b6b17c0fdbf8ba.png
 Lilliputian Elixir: Reduces your character's size by half when consumed.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44564361/d89ec929b0e686dd3b755a3352d15d63170ffcbb.png


The effects of these potions last for five minutes, after which they return to their original state. At the end of the event, the potions will be removed from the game, so only purchase what you intend to use!

You have already read the story of Kenrush. The annual related event is celebrated in the spirit of foolishness by the inhabitants of the imperial city, and the period is quickly dubbed "prank day".

May fun and pranks be at the heart of every adventurer this week!

M2M Team

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.5.6.3
notes.content:
The following changes were added during today's real-time maintenance!

Character abilities


 Increased the recharge time of the Shaman Heal ability from 20 to 40 seconds.
 Increased the recharge time of the Shaman Lightning Claw ability from 15 to 20 seconds.


Optimization

 Optimized the Wolf Shaman forest.
 Optimized the Minotaur Fortress.
 Optimized the Witch Queen Forest.
 Optimized the Lost Empire
 Optimized in the Land of the Dead


Other

 Greatly increased the amount of gold you can get from your opponents (all maps)
 Wildar, Eormenor and Mino's spirit chests now have optolos.
 Optolo gear is now more likely to be available from the Naga Queen and Spider Queen chests.
 The description of the gold bar now shows its value converted to gold.
 The price of optolos has been reduced by 50%
 The Cloak of Courage is now available for trade.
 Magic stone now gives a percentage mana bonus ( 10% - 30% )
 Defense Stone now gives a percentage defense bonus ( 10% - 30% )


Battleground Arena


 Achievements in Battleground as well as trophies obtained by the character are now displayed as separate tabs in the Profile window.
 We have changed the small map that appears in the top right corner under the battlegrounds: - The entire battleground will be continuously visible. - The background of the small map can be removed using the eye icon in the top left corner.
 The elements of the group UI can now be moved, the settings UI can be unlocked and the original layout can be restored using the corresponding buttons.


Issue Fixes


 Addressed an issue where Power Hunting losses and gains were not being recorded.
 Improved the clarity of the warning text when exiting Observer mode.
 Resolved a bug that allowed players to sign up for the Battlegrounds game mode, which is currently not permitted.
 Fixed the situation where players were being placed in one of the Battleground groups even as spectators.
 Corrected the display of actual values for wins and losses in the stats GUI.
 Fixed a bug that caused an uneven distribution when creating battles.
 Continuously updated the Battleground Observer Mode leaderboard.
 Closed a gap in Wolf-Shaman and the Harbor neighborhood.
 Enhanced the mechanism that refills the lives of bosses when they no longer perceive a threat.
 Improved Movement Speed bonuses to apply in all situations.
 Addressed the issue where typing long texts in chat would hide the full text until the window was resized.
 Fixed a bug where Intelligence was not properly affecting Petrun's Disable ability.
 Resolved the conflict where two Big Warehouse bonuses could be active simultaneously.
 Corrected the damage output of Shaman staffs' 2nd hit.
 Fixed the issue where the linked inventory would sometimes shift while moving.
 Adjusted the character menu button lighting to only appear when there is a skill or stat point ready to be deployed.
 Addressed various graphical issues in the Witch Queen's area.
 Fixed instances where characters would become stuck in demon gates, not attacking, and their health would constantly replenish.
 Prevented item loss when there was insufficient space to repack items during a withdrawn trade.
 Restored the music in the Witch Queen's Realm.
 Fixed a graphical bug that caused characters' faces to shatter while in hiding.
 Improved the reliability of the online GM list, ensuring that GMs consistently appear on the list and reflect their availability accurately.
 Resolved inaccuracies in the map placement of certain quest NPCs.
 Corrected the displayed attack value for the Petrun Flame Shards ability.
 Fixed a bug in Naga Run that caused the Minotaur ghost to slide on the ground instead of walking.
 Fixed an issue where the Master of Stone Evasion stone would give Defense instead of Dodge.
 Fixed a special fix has been implemented due to the game maps loading late. (Required Steam update)
 Fixed an issue where the icons of some power stones were duplicating each other.
 Fixed an issue with getting stuck on the login screen.
 Fixed a walking issue in the capital city due to a collider calculation issue. (Arena Stairs)
 Fixed an issue that caused remnants to remain on maps after events ended.


The game is finished, but the development is far from over. More exciting innovations are coming soon! Thank you for your signals, help and patience so far. We are counting on you in the future! We wish everyone a pleasant time in the world of Magic To Master!

notes.title: P.A.T.C.H Notes V.1.5.6.2
notes.content:
P.A.T.C.H Notes V.1.5.6.2
---
World Improvements:

 Changed the visual design of the capital city, removed the collider for walking and crossing issues in some areas.
 Fixed the sound effect issue with small pools and torches in the capital city map.
 Fixed a bug in 'terrain' in the Wolfshaman Forests that caused the player character to fall off the map.


NPC and Quest Improvements:

 "Market Place Manager" NPC's name has been changed to 'Market Place'.
 A special indicator has been placed on the 'Market Place' NPC's to indicate that it is related to trade.
 On the quarantine island, 'Healer' has been placed in the teleport area in the Capital for those who were unable to deliver the 'Report for Healer' quest.
 Fixed a quest bug that prevented access to King Guivre valley.
 Improved the design of the Petrun character.


Fixing In-Game Bugs:

 Fixed a bug x8492E-CODE that caused the item to disappear when upgrading items.
 Fixed a signing bug that caused heclient.dll to be deleted on client startup (restart steam for this)
 A new setting has been selectively added to the "**ESC>Game options>target board**" tab so that when the target is right-clicked, their current rate will appear above the HP and Mana bars.
 Fixed a screen GUI bug x8491E-CODE related to PlayerHUD.
 Fixed a slippage in Sculp.
 Fixed a GUI bug overriding mouse sensitivity.
 Fixed a bug where the cursor would not appear in the game when you selected the original mouse cursor.
 Fixed a script bug that was blocking the countdown timer when you log in to Naga Run.


Difficulty Levels and Group Requirements:

 Minotaur Run has been reduced from requiring a group of at least 4 people to 2 for playtest servers.
 Wuzhein Run has been reduced to 2 people for playtest servers, requiring a group of at least 5 people.
 Fixed a bug that increased the difficulty of the "Black Wolf" gangs on Quarantine Island and reduced them to normal level (they die easily now).


Various Improvements:

 Fixed multiple bugs in English translations.
 Fixed a bug when adding stones to items (Armor and Weapons).
 Fixed a bug that was causing items (Armor and Weapons) to constantly break when adding gems.
 The limit of 5 character creation per account has been increased to 25 on playtest servers.
 Fixed a bug that caused ,,Black Wolf'' mobs on Quarantine Island to give 100% poisoning.
 Increased the XP and HeroPoint rates given out by ,,Black Wolf'' mobs on Quarantine Island.
 Caching speed of loading screens (loading_screen) has been increased. So you will be able to log in faster.
 PerCCU (per player) server calculation technical values have been upgraded to improve ping, lag and loss issues by 30.004%.
 The DirectX-based advanced optimization module has been installed on the server, so it now offers a better graphics-based display.

notes.title: P.A.T.C.H Notes V.1.5.6.1
notes.content:
Server & Network Version: v100.5H
Client Version: E2.1.1
__ 

Dear Players

We are excited to announce the latest patch for our beloved game, which includes exciting new content, improvements and bug fixes that will take your gaming experience to a whole new level! With the release of version 2.1.1, we truly value your feedback and support and hope these improvements will make your journey in the game more enjoyable and rewarding. Thank you for being part of our vibrant community! Stay tuned for more adventures and happy gaming!

- The base bonus values of some mobs have been changed.
- Some minor and major UI based changes have been implemented.
- Optimization and improvements to Lost Empire, Quarantine Island, Zorandor and a few other maps.
- Fixed bugs in some of the missions.
- Fixed a bug with no bonuses for items.
- Fixed a bug where the game camera would sometimes stay inside the wall.
- Fixed a bug where the "M" large map would open and not show NPC's.
- Fixed items that were supposed to be timed but their durations were not working.
- Fixed some translation bugs.
- Fixed a bug with animations (Petrun)
- Fixed a delay in animations (Mage)
- Fixed an issue with the Mage class not being able to deal damage.
- Replaced missing NPCs in the Wolf-Shaman forest, White witch queen empire, and Cursed Warlord map.
- Healer and Nurse have been placed in the Capital teleport arena for those who forgot to turn in the quest on Quarantine Island.
- Mixer not working on some maps in game soundtracks and sounds, will be updated.
- Due to an issue with some data not being cached in the game, update has been issued on Steam.
NOTE:[/b ]The Steam update will reset your cache to store data cached by the remote repository on your computer. This is why your first login to the game after the update will be very, very slow. This is because it is trying to do caching. Remember that every time you visit a part of the game, if it is the first time, it will load very late. However, the second time it will load at its normal speed. You need to wait patiently for this.

Please restart Steam for strong and healthy game communication.

We are with you on the adventure,
Your M2M Team
